task: open the top drawer and put the bowl inside

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the handle of the top drawer on the dark cabinet.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the handle of the top drawer on the dark cabinet.
Approach the handle of the top drawer with the open gripper, descending from above to position for a grasp.
Approach the handle of the top drawer from above, lowering the open gripper to position it for opening.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the handle of the top drawer on the dark cabinet.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the handle of the top drawer on the dark cabinet.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the top drawer.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the handle of the top drawer.
Approach the open top drawer from above, lowering the empty gripper into its interior.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper into the open top drawer.
Approach the bowl inside the open top drawer from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the handle of the open top drawer with the gripper fingers.
Lift the gripper upward from the open top drawer.
Lift the bowl up from the table, moving it toward the open top drawer.
Lift the bowl up off the table, holding it above the open drawer.
Carry the bowl horizontally toward the open top drawer.
Lower the bowl down into the open top drawer.
Release the bowl into the open top drawer.
Release the bowl into the open top drawer and open the gripper.
